title: Canonical memory adapter over Forge, bridge, semantic-memory, and runtime
acceptance: Can insert a claim, supersede it retroactively, and answer both “what was true at valid time V” and “what did we believe at recorded time R”.
MemoryRequired app fails doctor/run if no memory store is configured.
No destructive update changes historical belief without supersession receipt.
forbidden: Do not implement memory as unversioned key-value notes.
Do not collapse valid time and recorded time into one timestamp.
